description: A data class representing a Note entity used within the app, including properties for id, title, content, tags, timestamps, and utility functions for tags conversion.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Domain model for a Note used by the app UI and repository. Contains properties for note data and helper methods.

methods.name: tagsCsv
methods.description: Converts the list of tags into a comma-separated string with trimmed tags.

methods.name: fromCsv
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string into a list of trimmed, non-empty tags.
